name: aria-correctness
description: Evaluates factual accuracy and correctness of ARIA's responses at Meridian Bank.

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: All facts correct and verifiable from the conversation or tool outputs.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Mostly correct; one minor inaccuracy that does not mislead the customer.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Partially correct; a notable error exists but the core answer is right.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Significant factual errors that would mislead the customer.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Entirely incorrect or completely invented information.
